technical.summary: Bullish short-term momentum with hull flip and rising RSI/OBV, but overbought conditions, weak trend strength (ADX 13.62), and bearish intermediate structure (below EMA200, MACD negative) limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 2 days present elevated volatility risk with weak fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Congressional selling pressure (3 sales, one substantial $50-100K) combined with market fear (40 fear/greed score) and bearish AAII sentiment (42% bearish) creates a potential contrarian buy setup, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (162+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (346.7), flat yield curve, rising USD, FOMC in 1 day, and earnings binary event in 2 days create compounded risk environment unsuitable for directional positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip up with rising RSI(9) and OBV provide short-term momentum confirmation near support (54.57), offering a defined risk entry point in a fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 2 days, VIX crisis levels (346.7), FOMC tomorrow, price below EMA200/EMA50, MACD bearish, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create compounded tail risks that overwhelm technical momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and rising RSI(9)/OBV provide short-term momentum confirmation at support, but earnings binary in 2 days and VIX crisis levels (346.7) create unacceptable tail risk for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 2 days combined with FOMC decision tomorrow and VIX at crisis levels creates binary volatility event that can gap through technical support regardless of momentum setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; technical momentum insufficient to overcome macro/fundamental headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AOS position with 16 existing Industrials positions (29.6% sector concentration); earnings proximity and concentration argue against adding exposure.
